1a9b51ee.text:
Archmage Khadgar of the Kirin Tor

Former apprentice of Medivh. Supreme Commander of the Alliance Expedition that marched into the $r homeworld of Draenor. Presumed deceased. 

Never did one so selflessly delve into the dark heart of magic and warfare. We wish you well, bold wanderer. Wherever you are. 

- Antonidas - Archmage of Dalaran
1a9b51ee.title: Archmage Khadgar

28e9b855.text:
The Mauradine Centaur of Desolace.

When you use shamanism to empower your people, it demands harmony with nature. The wind answers your call because it chooses to. You are its champion, and it becomes the power that lets your people soar. However, the Mauradine have no respect for this balance.

This particular clan has only wielded this power for selfish gain. Hunting parties flying across the plains to stalk their foes, spellcasters channeling great storms to burn villages. And even this is not enough. They have created totems of hideous power, forcing the elements to bend to their will.

It is not for us to decide Azeroth's desires, but one thing is clear. The Mauradine are no friends to the elements.
28e9b855.title: The Walks of Shaman

57d4e03b.text:
The Mirefin Murlocs of Dustwallow Marsh.

Murlocs have an innate connection to water as any seafolk, but in a curious way. Many species can recognize the elements in nature without tapping directly into it. The murlocs, however, not only can call upon water, but wield it with surprising intelligence.

Their oracles have a curious affinity for restorative magic. Water is a source of healing for all creatures, from hydration to medicine, but the murlocs managed to tap into its even deeper sources of power. What takes some adepts decades to master, some murlocs seem to be born with this gift.

If this were any other $c, one would think this to be a blessing. But they are murlocs, after all. Their healing magic is as much a weapon as any other, keeping their hunters sharp and their shores battle-ready. Using totems is curious for a species like this, but make no mistake. They are as corrupt as their masters.
57d4e03b.title: The Walks of Shaman

78d3fd0c.text:
Azeroth is home to a host of brilliant creatures. It shows no favoritism. If you learn to listen to her, feel her presence and answer her call, it is simple to wield her strengths.

With time and patience anyone can hear the elements, but our totems lend us a conduit with which to channel this power. More civilized cultures only bestow a totem on those who have proven themselves worthy, but a suitably powerful $c can create one at will.

We have seen such creatures wield the elements for evil. With enough corruption in the land, Azeroth cries out for protectors against these twisted totems. With enough of the corrupted conduits, one can even call upon the tainted elements and banish them back to the planes.
78d3fd0c.title: The Walks of Shaman

85302983.text:
The Stonevault Troggs and Dustbelcher Ogres of the Badlands.

The element of fire is often misunderstood as a source of destruction. While uncontrolled fire is indeed the mark of an uncontrolled spirit, a focused flame lights homes and staves off the bitter cold. A people who learn to master this element are sure to be prosperous--both in battle and at home.

Troggs are rather simple creatures. They aren't known for great demonstrations of power or even particularly cohesive aggression. It wasn't until their discovery of fire that they were even considered a culture worth investigating. But the elements show no favoritism.

Ogres, on the other hand, are known for their strength, cruelty, and even cunning. They forge alliances, and fight in organized groups. They can be quick to turn on their allies and each other, embodying fire's spread and fury.

The element of fire may respect keeping these cultures alive, but certainly not how their totems have been used for blind cruelty.
85302983.title: The Walks of Shaman

bc13bd7f.text:
The Lost Ones of the Swamp of Sorrows.

Earth is the element of fortitude and steadiness. A $c capable of harnessing the earth's power can guarantee their people sturdy homes and durable warriors. What could otherwise flatten another combatant can be shrugged off by one gifted by the powers of earth.

It can also be used to crumble others.

When left to their devices, the Lost Ones rarely interfere with the goings on of other cultures. They stalk about in a mindless fugue state as if they don't truly belong anywhere. The only thing that offers them grounding is the elements.

Unlike the others mentioned, it is not necessarily believed that the Lost Ones have a genuine desire for harm. Earth offers them solace in their aimless wandering. However, with this comes their dependence.

Calling on the elements for aid is one thing, but demanding their presence is another. They are our guides, not our crutches. Now their totems are just as twisted as the Lost Ones themselves.
bc13bd7f.title: The Walks of Shaman

10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11047|7530984f.name: Kray
11047|7530984f.text: Bena works like one possessed. Day and night I have seen her bent over these potions, often going without sleep or food. I know our undead allies need help, but I begin to fear she will do herself an injury.

11047|c719a0fa.name: Kray
11047|c719a0fa.text: I must have broken hundreds of vials when I first began brewing potions. The glass was so fragile in my clumsy hands. I hope you are more cautious than I was.

11047|f018918d.name: Kray
11047|f018918d.text: Your capacity for learning has outstripped mine. You will need to talk to Bena Winterhoof over there for further instruction. Please don't take too much of her time, though. She needs her rest.

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

11956|0359e6b8.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|0359e6b8.text:
Strength of the heart is what gives you the resolve to take action... action that is rooted in intents that are pure and forthright.  To keep the balance is not to be complacent or banal.

You must show resolve for that which you believe in, and you must be willing to fight for it.  The mother bear shows endless conviction in protecting her young, as does an elder bear protecting his den.  It is this resolve, this strength of heart, which you must come to know if you are to master the way of the Claw.

11956|2c9200b5.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|2c9200b5.text:
I represent the strength which bolsters you as a young $c.  You have come to me to learn this strength, young one, and I will teach this to you.  I will teach you all that is the spirit bear, provided you will listen and understand.

In order to know what it means to draw upon my spirit, you need to understand the importance of the strength of the body, as well as the strength of the heart.

11956|59f9a1e9.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|59f9a1e9.text:
It remains to be seen if you are ready, young one.  Even the wisest and oldest of druids are never truly ready when their ultimate time of testing comes.

You have heard my words, and now you must move on.  Heed what I have taught you.  There will be a time when you will have your strength tested.  You must face your foe as the bear would - with strength of body and with strength of heart.  Learn from the fight, young one.  Go... with my blessings.

11956|86efb831.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|86efb831.text:
The bear spirit looks upon you with a calm and peaceful gaze.  You hear a voice speak to you as though it was coming from the bear, but the creature makes no indication that it is speaking.

"Greetings, my young friend.  If you have come to me seeking guidance, then perhaps I can help you find what you seek."

11956|d6a631ca.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|d6a631ca.text:
Strength of the body is the power and swiftness of action.  You must keep yourself fit at all times, both physically and mentally.  The bear's girth highlights its strength, as it is a ferocious foe in combat.  The bear's girth, however, belies its lithe agility and sharp mind.  These are surprises you will use to your advantage.

You must rely on the strength of the bear's body in order to master the way of the Claw.

12042|cf843c85.name: Loganaar
12042|cf843c85.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

12144|8e6ce242.name: Lunaclaw Spirit
12144|8e6ce242.text:
The spirit looks intently into your eyes and grasps your hand.  You feel a warmth shoot through your body, almost knocking you to your knees.

As the warmth passes, you feel the slight presence of an ursine spirit within your being... bolstering your resolve.

12144|ac452739.name: Lunaclaw Spirit
12144|ac452739.text: The slain spirit of Lunaclaw stares at you intently, as though wanting something from you.

12740|c5ceacbe.name: Faustron
12740|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2410|8b3451aa.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
2410|8b3451aa.text: My studies take me far from the Under City, but to truly learn one must be near to the source of knowledge.

269127|28c049d4.name: Image of Archmage Modera
269127|28c049d4.text:
You've likely heard that Dalaran is suffering from a magical outbreak, and all of our mages are too preoccupied maintaining the city's wards to effectively contain it.

I'd do anything to protect my city, $r. Even consorting with the likes of you.

2798|a28d29e1.name: Pand Stonebinder
2798|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2988|00c35128.name: Morin Cloudstalker
2988|00c35128.text: The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the $r homeland risk punishment at our hands.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3009|23b0a36f.name: Bena Winterhoof
3009|23b0a36f.text: I cannot in good conscience spend time training novices while our allies, the undead, are suffering so terribly. Please speak with Kray over there instead; he can help you for now.

3009|490d29e8.name: Bena Winterhoof
3009|490d29e8.text: Can you not sense the anguish of the Earth Mother for her lost children, the undead? Speak quickly, $N. Every second costs me dearly. We must help them find their way back to her!

3033|8fca8484.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3033|febb65fa.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|febb65fa.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3036|d1e27715.name: Kym Wildmane
3036|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3052|25d0fbd5.name: Skorn Whitecloud
3052|25d0fbd5.text: Come closer, young one.  In my time I could hear the flutter of a prey's beating heart, but now you must speak up if you want your words heard.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3064|03bae58c.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|03bae58c.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

3084|a56de79f.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a56de79f.text: First Aid is always a nice skill to have.  Many a time during battle has it saved my hide.  Visit Spiritual Healing on the Spirit Rise.  Pand Stonebinder can teach you all you need to know to save your hide as well.

3084|c52e88b9.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|c52e88b9.text: Seek out Turak Runetotem in the Hall of Elders on the Elder Rise.

3084|f99c1e68.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|f99c1e68.text: The herbs found in nature can be a powerful ally when combined with respect.  You will want to seek out Bena at her alchemy shop on the middle rise to further your training.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3373|6043e59b.name: Arnok
3373|6043e59b.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4604|3a39b135.name: Abigail Sawyer
4604|3a39b135.text: Words are like arrows. Once loosed, you cannot call them back.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

1061-accept.name: Zor Lonetree
1061-accept.text:
The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land.  So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon.  She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.

Meet Seereth in Stonetalon.  To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads.  She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
1061-accept.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1492-accept.name: Apothecary Helbrim
1492-accept.text:
I have need to send a crate of potions, reagents and other items to my associates in the Old World. Little time I have to actually see them to the dock at Ratchet, and the last caravan has already left.

If you could, please take this to Wharfmaster Dizzywig. He will ensure that it is placed on the next boat to Blackwater Cove.
1492-accept.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1492-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-complete.text:
A small enough crate. Yes, I should be able to find room for this aboard the ship. It sails with the next tide, I trust this is soon enough? Excellent. Let me just enter it into my ledger.

All taken care of! Good day to you, $c.
1492-complete.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1492-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-progress.text: You seek passage on the next ship, or have some item you wish to send aboard it?
1492-progress.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

264-accept.name: Clarice Foster
264-accept.text:
Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, $N! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
264-accept.title: Until Death Do Us Part

5041-accept.name: Thork
5041-accept.text:
That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.

The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
5041-accept.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

544-complete.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
544-complete.text:
You have done a great service for the Forsaken, $N. These artifacts have been sorely missed.

And it is good to hear that Kegan and the other betrayers have found justice.
544-complete.title: Prison Break In

544-progress.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
544-progress.text: Did you find the thieves? And more importantly, did you find what they stole?
544-progress.title: Prison Break In

545-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
545-accept.text:
Before it mysteriously vanished, there was an enormous magical barrier around the newly-reconstructed city of Dalaran. I care not what caused such a magical marvel to fail, but I do care that the newly exposed outskirts of their city may hide valuable magical treasures. Vestiges of the ruins on which the new city is built. 

But the area is patrolled by the wizards and their elemental slaves.

So hunt them, and return when their numbers are sufficiently reduced.
545-accept.title: Dalaran Patrols

545-complete.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
545-complete.text:
Very good. Thank you, $N.

Now we are free to pay Dalaran a little visit.
545-complete.title: Dalaran Patrols

5722-accept.name: Rahauro
5722-accept.text:
The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.

Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.

Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
5722-accept.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5723-accept.name: Rahauro
5723-accept.text:
Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the $r people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.

She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
5723-accept.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5726-accept.name: Thrall
5726-accept.text:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
5726-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5761-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-accept.text:
The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.

If they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.

Kill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
5761-accept.title: Slaying the Beast

5922-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
5922-accept.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade, $r and night elf alike.  Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there.  Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there.  Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on.  Good luck, young $c.
5922-accept.title: Moonglade

5922-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5922-complete.text:
And so it begins, Father Cenarius.  And so it begins.

<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him.  A slight aura of power falls over him.>

The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear.  I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!
5922-complete.title: Moonglade

5928-accept.name: Gennia Runetotem
5928-accept.text:
Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you.  It seems that your training as a $c is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally.  Turak is one of the Arch $C's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient $c, and he should teach you well.

He is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.
5928-accept.title: Heeding the Call

5928-complete.name: Turak Runetotem
5928-complete.text:
I am glad you found your way here today, young $c.  The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature.  Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges.  We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own.  Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

Ready yourself!
5928-complete.title: Heeding the Call

5930-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5930-accept.text:
In the northwest part of Moonglade resides the home of a wise and noble being we call the Great Bear Spirit.  For all druids, it has served as a tutor and mentor into the first true natural understanding of the bear.  All druids at one point seek the spirit's wisdom, and you shall be no exception.

Go to the Great Bear Spirit now and learn what it will teach.  When it is satisfied with you, return to me here in Nighthaven.  We will then see if you have truly taken account of the lessons it teaches.
5930-accept.title: Great Bear Spirit

5930-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5930-complete.text:
<Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach.  Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>

I sense wisdom in you, young one, that was not present when we first met.  You gaze upon me with strength and knowing intent, though this intent is yet not focused.  You will now learn to focus your strength and adopt the nature of the bear into your work.
5930-complete.title: Great Bear Spirit

5932-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5932-accept.text:
The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me.  Though the $r are thought to be young in the ways of Cenarius, Turak Runetotem walks with much balance in the presence of nature.  Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.

Go now, young one.  We shall meet again.
5932-accept.title: Back to Thunder Bluff

5932-complete.name: Turak Runetotem
5932-complete.text:
Welcome back, $N.  I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the Claw... a little bewildering, but very intense.  I know it was that way with me.

The Great Bear Spirit has been a part of Azeroth as long as Azeroth has existed in the heavens.  We $r listen closely to such spirits, and we all prosper from its purpose.  Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose.  Listen closely...
5932-complete.title: Back to Thunder Bluff

6002-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
6002-accept.text:
On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone.  The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts.  Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it.  Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, $N... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a $c!
6002-accept.title: Body and Heart

6002-complete.name: Turak Runetotem
6002-complete.text:
You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, $N.  I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.

There are no further obstacles in your way... let me now teach you what it means to be a $C of the Claw!
6002-complete.title: Body and Heart

6002-progress.name: Turak Runetotem
6002-progress.text: When you have faced the challenge that lies before you, your understanding of strength of body and strength of heart will be fully realized.  Until that time, I cannot help you further.
6002-progress.title: Body and Heart

6361-accept.name: Jahan Hawkwing
6361-accept.text:
I have a bundle of hides from the animals of the Barrens, and must get them to Thunder Bluff.  A colleague there, Ahanu, will use the hides to create leather goods.

Will you take the hides to him for me?

The quickest way to Thunder Bluff is on the back of a wind rider.  Bring the bundle of hides to Devrak, our wind rider master in the Crossroads, and speak to him about transport to Thunder Bluff.
6361-accept.title: A Bundle of Hides

6361-complete.name: Devrak
6361-complete.text: If you must take these hides to Thunder Bluff, then you are speaking to the right orc!
6361-complete.title: A Bundle of Hides

6361-progress.name: Devrak
6361-progress.text: Are you here for a wind rider?  You have something to transport?
6361-progress.title: A Bundle of Hides

6362-accept.name: Devrak
6362-accept.text:
For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff.  There's no faster way to the city!

If that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.

If you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff.  And that's right where you'll land!
6362-accept.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff

743-complete.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-complete.text: You have done well, $N. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
743-complete.title: Dangers of the Windfury

743-progress.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-progress.text: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
743-progress.title: Dangers of the Windfury

744-accept.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-accept.text:
$N, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

I want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?

You can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
744-accept.title: Preparation for Ceremony

744-complete.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-complete.text:
Thank you for your help, $N.

My part in my brother's ceremony is almost complete. Giving him his headdress and witnessing the ceremony are all my duty requires of me.
744-complete.title: Preparation for Ceremony

744-progress.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-progress.text: This headdress will certainly be a wonderful gift for my brother.
744-progress.title: Preparation for Ceremony

746-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  This will calm the beasts of Mulgore.  And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.
746-complete.title: Dwarven Digging

746-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have the Broken Tools?  The dwarves' digging will enrage the kodos of Mulgore.  This defilement must be stopped!
746-progress.title: Dwarven Digging

756-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
756-complete.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-progress.text: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756-progress.title: Thunderhorn Totem

758-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-accept.text:
The totem is ready, $N. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.

May the spirits guide you.
758-accept.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

758-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-complete.text:
Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.

For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
758-complete.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

759-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-accept.text:
There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.

Alphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.
759-accept.title: Wildmane Totem

759-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-complete.text: Very good, $N. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.
759-complete.title: Wildmane Totem

759-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-progress.text: $N.  Do you have the teeth I asked for?
759-progress.title: Wildmane Totem

760-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
760-accept.text:
Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young $N. The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.

The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. Perform the ritual! Heal the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!
760-accept.title: Wildmane Cleansing

760-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
760-complete.text:
You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, $N.

May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.
760-complete.title: Wildmane Cleansing

764-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
764-complete.text: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. will know not to take the $r lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.
764-complete.title: The Venture Co.

765-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-complete.text: My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. Thank you for your efforts, $N.
765-complete.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

772-complete.name: Seer Wiserunner
772-complete.text: Be not afraid, $N. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
772-complete.title: Rite of Vision

773-accept.name: Seer Wiserunner
773-accept.text:
To gain acceptance amongst the elders of Thunder Bluff you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.

Now that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.

Travel east of Thunder Bluff, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, $N.
773-accept.title: Rite of Wisdom

773-complete.name: Ancestral Spirit
773-complete.text:
You have shown great diligence in your yearning to pass the Rites of the Earthmother, $N.

We, the Ancestral Spirits, represent the mighty $r who gave their lives bravely to found and protect our great city of Thunder Bluff. I hereby pass the duty of that protection over to you.

You have passed the Rite of Wisdom, young $c. Enter Thunder Bluff with pride.
773-complete.title: Rite of Wisdom

775-accept.name: Ancestral Spirit
775-accept.text:
You will now be revered within our great city. Any $r worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.

For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.
775-accept.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff

775-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
775-complete.text: Hail, young $c. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
775-complete.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff

776-accept.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-accept.text:
You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.

But in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.

We are hunters, $N. Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
776-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

776-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-complete.text:
Well done! A fine kill that was.

I will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.

You have done a great deed for your people, $N.
776-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

776-progress.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-progress.text: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
776-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

833-accept.name: Lorekeeper Raintotem
833-accept.text:
Only the most valiant $r are laid to rest at Red Rocks, our sacred burial ground. It is an honor bestowed upon the great warriors who helped found and defend Thunder Bluff and those who have given their lives for the greater good of their tribes and chieftains.

But it appears a foul menace has made its way onto our holy land. A band of Bristleback Interlopers is ravaging the grave site and I am too old and past my prime to drive them away.

They must be driven off with force, $N.
833-accept.title: A Sacred Burial

833-complete.name: Lorekeeper Raintotem
833-complete.text: Well done. You have sent those foul Bristlebacks a clear message. They will think twice before attempting to meddle in this holy spot again.
833-complete.title: A Sacred Burial

844-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-accept.text:
Your first prey will be easy.

The plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.

Put down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
844-accept.title: Plainstrider Menace

848-accept.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-accept.text:
The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery.  Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.

Invigorating, and altering.

There is a mushroom that grows near these oases.  Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.

Bring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
848-accept.title: Fungal Spores

854-accept.name: Kirge Sternhorn
854-accept.text:
I have foreseen your arrival, young $c. Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.

I think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.

It is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
854-accept.title: Journey to the Crossroads

854-complete.name: Thork
854-complete.text: It is good to see that more of our $r allies have come to assist us from as far away as Thunder Bluff. Again, I welcome you.
854-complete.title: Journey to the Crossroads

860-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
860-accept.text:
If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens.  Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce.  You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.

Speak with Sergra Darkthorn.  She will be your first guide in the Barrens.

Sergra is at the Crossroads.  To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks.  And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.
860-accept.title: Sergra Darkthorn

860-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
860-complete.text:
You want to hunt in the Barrens?

Your eyes are eager, and young.  They're not yet squinted from tracking your prey across this land's dry plains.

But worry not. We'll toughen your body and your mind.  And we'll teach you that there is more to hunting than finding and killing your quarry.

Prepare yourself.  Your journey begins.  Now.
860-complete.title: Sergra Darkthorn

861-accept.name: Skorn Whitecloud
861-accept.text:
You are eager to explore, I can tell.  I too had the lust to wander, once...

Wander, and hunt.  For hunting is a $R's greatest honor.

If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path.  He is in Thunder Bluff, on the Hunter's Rise.

And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore.  They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young $c on the hunter's path.
861-accept.title: The Hunter's Way

861-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
861-complete.text:
Skorn Whitecloud is a wise $r.  He has hunted for years and years, and although his body is old, his spirit burns fiercely.  We are honored to have him with us.

If Skorn sent you to me, then  you too must have the hunter's spirit.  And to have gathered these claws shows your burgeoning skills.

Perhaps you are ready to walk the path.
861-complete.title: The Hunter's Way

861-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
861-progress.text: Greetings.  There is an air about you that tells me much.  Do we have business, you and I?
861-progress.title: The Hunter's Way

865-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-accept.text:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
865-accept.title: Raptor Horns

866-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
866-accept.text:
The herbs of the Barrens are not quite like herbs in other lands.  Their properties are mostly the same, but the oasis water here alters the plants; they are just slightly different.

I want to study those differences... to see if they're exploitable!

If you are skilled in herbalism, then gather root samples off the herbs you find in the Barrens.  Bring back these samples so that I may compare them with herbs from other regions.
866-accept.title: Root Samples

867-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-accept.text:
The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...
867-accept.title: Harpy Raiders

869-accept.name: Gazrog
869-accept.text:
Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower.  It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.

The strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft.  And... it was a raptor!  Unbelievable!

I don't know what raptors would want with silver.  But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!

Hunt raptors in the Barrens.  Collect for me their heads!
869-accept.title: Raptor Thieves

870-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
870-accept.text:
Long ago, the Barrens was a lush place, teeming with life.  But war and cataclysm raged across the land, scorching it and leaving a dry husk.  Such is the way of things, and it saddens my heart.

But within the past few years, new oases have formed in the Barrens, and life stirs.  And deep down, we druids sense a power leaking its way to the surface.

We must find its source.  Travel to the Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads.  Search its waters for a source of power, then return here.
870-accept.title: The Forgotten Pools

871-accept.name: Thork
871-accept.text:
All the quilboars are our enemies, $N. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.

The Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from Durotar, causing us no end of annoyance. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.

Start in the northeast towards Durotar. You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. Seek them out, and slay them.
871-accept.title: Disrupt the Attacks

886-accept.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
886-accept.text:
The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.

Tonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.

Travel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga.  He will be at the Crossroads.  To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village.  Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks.  Continue north and  you will find the Crossroads.

And do not leave the road, $N, for the Barrens is a harsh land.
886-accept.title: The Barrens Oases

886-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
886-complete.text:
My brethren in Thunder Bluff were wise to send you, young $c.  For the mystery of the Barrens is one that I alone cannot unravel.

With your aid, let us hope we can find answers to our questions.
886-complete.title: The Barrens Oases

887-accept.name: Gazlowe
887-accept.text:
I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!

I heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
887-accept.title: Southsea Freebooters

891-accept.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-accept.text:
Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!

Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
891-accept.title: The Guns of Northwatch

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

895-accept.name: Unknown
895-accept.text:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe
895-accept.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-accept.text:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
896-accept.title: Miner's Fortune

92434-progress.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92434-progress.text:
Stay your weapon, $r.

I think you will find that key won't be enough to get past my wards. You didn't truly think we would leave such a vulnerability open at a time like this, did you?
92434-progress.title: Blood in the Streets

93680-progress.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
93680-progress.text: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?
93680-progress.title: Key to the City

96984-progress.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
96984-progress.text: You were right to come straight back to me. Have you found anything in Dalaran?
96984-progress.title: Heart of Disruption

96987-accept.name: Unknown
96987-accept.text:
Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $r!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
96987-accept.title: Opportunistic Education

96987-complete.name: Unknown
96987-complete.text:
I guess I shouldn't have sent a stooge to look for priceless artifacts. This is barely worth sellin' at a tourist kiosk! What, did you just grab the first book that seemed to be jutting out from the rest?

Forget it. Maybe I can spray it with gold and say it belonged to an arch mage or somethin'.
96987-complete.title: Opportunistic Education

96987-progress.name: Unknown
96987-progress.text: Well? Didja find their library? There's gotta be somethin' good in there.
96987-progress.title: Opportunistic Education

96988-complete.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-complete.text:
Cracked. Cracked. CRACKED.

I can't make use of any of these! I said disable the sentries, not obliterate them! How dangerous could they have been?

My dreams of magus abominations are at a standstill. For now.
96988-complete.title: Source of Power

96988-progress.name: Doctor Martin Felben
96988-progress.text: The value in these cores is that they are powerful. The downside is that means the constructs are powerful. Good luck.
96988-progress.title: Source of Power

97287-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
97287-complete.text:
You would give this... willingly?

I do not know your game, $r, but I cannot deny the value of your interference during this delicate time for our people. It's not within my power to grant you access to the city at this time, but someday... perhaps. For now, our thanks will have to suffice.
97287-complete.title: Shrewd Negotiations

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97485-complete.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-complete.text:
You have done well, friend.

I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, $N. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.

Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.

Go with An'she's warmth.
97485-complete.title: Traditions of the Bluff

98424-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98424-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
98424-progress.title: Fizsprocket's Notes
